name: SWWE World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: SWWE Fed's own top championship. Billed as previously held by Underdeath, then by Blaise as of the promotion's own 29 April 2007 card; by Unsurrender it was Salvador defending alongside Felix619 when Mr. Xtreme won it in a Hell in a Cell, per the promotion's own October 2007 news post.

name: Xplosion Championship
epitaph: SWWE Fed's own Xplosion brand championship. Rated Xtreme is billed by the promotion's own commentary as "the first-ever champion in SWWE Fed history," holding it through the 29 April 2007 card before losing it to Lashley in a triple threat also involving Eira at Unsurrender. A separate, undated line on the promotion's own 4 March 2007 card calls a wrestler billed as ".:Hardy:."

name: Underaction Championship
epitaph: SWWE Fed's own Underaction brand championship. Salvador is billed as champion on the promotion's own 29 April 2007 card; by Unsurrender, Rayden held it and lost it to Boy Killer, per the promotion's own October 2007 news post.

name: Xtreme Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Billed as held by Rated Xtreme and Felix619 (together, Rated-X) on the promotion's own 29 April 2007 card; no defense or title change survives in the documents read this pass.

name: AWA Championship
epitaph: The championship of AWA, SWWE Fed's own developmental territory, whose matches the promotion's own 29 April 2007 card says began that same night. rxnolasco is billed as the new champion, having won "a brutal match," at Unsurrender per the promotion's own October 2007 news post.
